capability.title: Content Factory
capability.summary: Brief in, channel-shaped copy out for every slot in the brief. Produces long-form once and shards it into channel-native short-form, which is why one research pass can feed a blog, five LinkedIn posts and an email without re-researching or contradicting itself.

with.note: Localisation is a separate capability, not a prompt instruction. It carries its own lexicon, its own compliance variant and its own reviewer.

with.code:
const items = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: { copy: items, slots_filled: items.length, anchor: $('Write Long-form').first()?.json || null } }];
